name: PTR character copy: a load interrupted before the character exists fails and frees the character
contract: The target realm claims a request (state Loading) before it loads the dump. If the realm stops before the copy's character is written, the next poll finds the claimed request, sees no character under the claimed GUID and marks it failed, so the source realm tells the player nothing changed and the character can be copied again. ptr_character_copy_interruption before_load stops the first claimed load at that point.

steps.label: The source account starts with one character
The copy is queued for the target realm
steps.text: Harnessquit is on its way to

steps.label: DISCRIMINATING: the interrupted request is recovered as failed and reported
steps.text: Nothing was changed there, so you can copy it again

steps.label: The interrupted load created no character
DISCRIMINATING: the recovered request no longer blocks a new copy
The new copy loads as a second character
Let the target realm poll the request table three more times
